input_classes: versioned Kaggle probe source and metadata
goal: Verify actual accelerator allocation against registered P43 capacity rather than inferring compatibility from a requested machine shape.
procedure: Request private NvidiaL4 hardware-only kernel with one persisted push; inspect torch device names and total memory; compare the existing 17754461984-byte projection against each allocated GPU's 85-percent bound; verify returned receipt and preserve remote identity; defer further GPU submissions until read-only push-log and remote metadata review.
constraints: No two-rank P43 inference or training claim
No rerun, silent accelerator substitution, model shrink, or 85-percent gate change
decision_criteria: Both actual GPUs are L4 with per-rank physical memory satisfying frozen P43 projected capacity
Requested metadata and allocated devices are tracked separately
validation: Owner pasted verified hardware-only output: requested NvidiaL4, actual Tesla T4 x2, 15636037632 bytes per device, projection_fraction 1.1354834518730328 and capacity_pass false for both; remote status insufficient_or_unavailable_hardware.
failure_or_lesson: Provider selection must confirm allocated hardware and associated memory, not infer from a CLI request or a generic product listing.
